Description
The University of Lancashire is based in Preston, in the north west of the UK. 24,000 students from 100 different countries are enrolled, making it one of the largest student bodies in the country. University of Lancashire became the first modern university to be named in the QS World Rankings, and has over 400 undergraduate and 200 postgraduate courses available. The University has been a leader in emerging disciplines such as Fashion and Forensic Science, as well as newer additions such as Dentistry and Aerospace Engineering. OnCampus UK North offers guaranteed progression onto a degree at University of Lancashire and students can also apply to any other UK university.
